explanation: Fires only at D1, and only when the previous trial was an a2 choice that went rarely to S1 and got no reward: then it is about 10 (8-10 if this repeats on back-to-back trials, and only about 2-4 late in the episode, around trial 85 and later). It is 0 at every GO and D2 step and at every other D1, including after rewarded trials, after an unrewarded common a2 to S2 trial, and after any unrewarded a1 trial (only rarely about 2 after an unrewarded a1 to S1 trial).
